title: Sector Nine Rising Again
author: Bram Kavanagh
blurb: Silas Blackwood, a xenolinguist who can no longer dream in human languages, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. Then a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
